_meta.source: BTS-Synthetic HRIS + buddy programme tracker (synthetic data)

buddy_rules.seniority_rule: Buddy should be at the same level as the new hire or one level above. Never the new hire's direct manager.
buddy_rules.location_rule: For hybrid roles, prefer a buddy who is in the same office on at least 2 of the new hire's office days.
buddy_rules.availability_rule: Buddy must be available (not on leave) for the new hire's first 2 weeks.
buddy_rules.training_rule: Buddy must have completed 'Buddy Basics' training.
